items.title: Getting Started with Google Antigravity
items.summary: 20 minutes flat to explore Antigravity, Google DeepMind’s agentic environment. A comprehensive overview of its building blocks:— Surfaces: Agent Manager, IDE, CLI, and SDK as well.— Autonomy: sub-agents, custom agents, skills, MCP servers, and slash commands.— Orchestration & control: Artifacts, Remote Control, sidecars, hooks, rules, and workflows.Ready to float in anti-gravity for your next development projects?
